question: If 27x³ – 64y³ = (Ax + By) (Cx² – Dy² + 12xy), then the value of 4A + B + 3C + 2D is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the algebraic identity: a³ − b³ = (a − b)(a² + ab + b²)

Here, 27x³ − 64y³ = (3x)³ − (4y)³ = (3x − 4y)(9x² + 12xy + 16y²)

Comparing with (Ax + By)(Cx² − Dy² + 12xy), we get:

A = 3, B = −4, C = 9, D = −16

Value = 4(3) + (−4) + 3(9) + 2(−16) = 12 − 4 + 27 − 32 = 3

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: 27x³ − 64y³ = (Ax + By) (Cx² − Dy² + 12xy)

Formula: a³ − b³ = (a − b)(a² + ab + b²)

⇒ 27x³ − 64y³ = (3x)³ − (4y)³

⇒ (3x − 4y)((3x)² + (3x)(4y) + (4y)²)

⇒ (3x − 4y)(9x² + 12xy + 16y²)

⇒ By comparing the coefficients with (Ax + By)(Cx² − Dy² + 12xy):

⇒ A = 3, B = −4, C = 9

⇒ −Dy² = 16y² ⇒ D = −16

⇒ Target expression = 4A + B + 3C + 2D

⇒ 4(3) + (−4) + 3(9) + 2(−16)

⇒ 12 − 4 + 27 − 32

⇒ 35 − 32 = 3

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Cubes Identity

The sum of cubes is given by a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² − ab + b²).

Square of a Binomial

The square identities are (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b² and (a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b².

Identity for (a + b + c)²

The square of a trinomial is (a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2(ab + bc + ca).</p
